text:
oliver: heads-up — new dev hit a weird combo in our monorepo when running the edge sample: ESM/CJS exports got mixed, types duplicated, and auth retries dropped headers.

tess: can you paste the runtime error?
oliver: Cloudflare dev: `The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/cjs/index.cjs' does not provide an export named 'default'` then later TS shows `Duplicate identifier 'ClientOptions'`. Also on retry the Authorization header disappears.

lee: that screams two physical installs + bundler choosing the CJS entry. Which package.json `exports` shape do we publish?
oliver: currently: 
```json
{"name":"@redwood/sdk","exports":{".":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs"}},"types":"./dist/index.d.ts"}
```

anya: edge bundlers sometimes pick `require` if `mainFields` prefer `main`. Also workspaces can create symlinked local packages plus a hoisted copy -> duplicate singletons and duplicate `.d.ts` exposures.

oliver: we use yarn classic workspaces (not PnP). `yarn why @redwood/sdk` shows hoisted, but `ls -la node_modules/@redwood/sdk` in the app shows a symlink to workspace package.

tess: short-term fixes to unblock the dev: 
- alias `@redwood/sdk` -> `node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/index.mjs` in the bundler config (esbuild/webpack/rollup),
- set esbuild/webpack `mainFields: ['module','browser','main']`,
- tsconfig: add `paths` mapping to point to hoisted types or `skipLibCheck: true` as a temporary workaround.

lee: for the auth retry: likely two AuthClient instances. We had success with a guarded dev-only global attach: `globalThis.__rw_auth__ = globalThis.__rw_auth__ || new AuthClient(...)` so retries resolve against the same global. It must be opt-in and documented.

anya: long-term SDK proposals: 
1) make an explicit ESM-first entry (add `browser` and `module` fields and ensure `exports` prefers `import`/`browser`),
2) publish a flattened `index.d.ts` at the top-level so workspaces don't import multiple declaration files,
3) avoid `node:` builtins in edge entry or provide tiny polyfills,
4) add a dev-only load counter: `globalThis.__rw_sdk_loads = (globalThis.__rw_sdk_loads||0)+1` and warn if >1 (include stack) — would have saved time.

oliver: created a tiny repro repo & steps in the issue. build-bot please open an issue.

build-bot: opened issue #1034: "devex: edge-sdk-workspace-esm-exports-typing-auth" with labels: devex, sdk, edge, monorepo. @oliver please attach pnpm/yarn lockfile and minimal repro.

tess: additional note for docs: quickstart should have a workspace section with recommended settings for yarn/pnpm, a minimal esbuild config snippet, and the alias example. Also call out stray lockfiles causing nested installs.

lee: test changes: add an esbuild bundle smoke test in CI that builds the sample edge function and verifies the bundle uses the ESM file (e.g., `bundle.includes("index.mjs")`).

anya: small retry fix: ensure our retry middleware recomputes auth headers per-retry (call a token getter) instead of reusing a possibly stale header object. Add unit tests that simulate header-preservation across retries.

oliver: applied the alias + skipLibCheck locally — new dev unblocked. Will attach the repro and logs to #1034. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
